company.name: Notabene
company.shortDescription: Notabene is the leading institutional transaction and payment messaging network for compliant stablecoin payments and crypto transactions
company.description:
Notabene was founded to build SWIFT for Crypto. Notabene Transact, their core offering is now processing $5B of transactions a day between thousands of regulated institutions for purposes. 
They just launched Notabene Flow, the only B2B focused VisaNet like pull payment layer for stablecoins to their network. Notabene Flow allows their network members to offer better high margin B2B high margin services, such as recurring and agentic cross border B2B payments that no one has been able to solve at scale using stablecoins.

productsAndServices.description: A pre-transaction compliance and authorization platform that automates Travel Rule data exchange, counterparty screening, self-hosted wallet identification, and risk-based approval of crypto transactions.
productsAndServices.name: Notabene Transact

productsAndServices.description: An API-driven stablecoin payments platform for business pay-ins, payouts, invoicing, and recurring payments, with counterparty verification and Travel Rule compliance built into settlement workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Notabene Flow

productsAndServices.description: A network of verified virtual asset service providers that enables institutions to discover counterparties, assess reachability, exchange compliance data, and coordinate regulated crypto transactions globally.
productsAndServices.name: Notabene Network

productsAndServices.description: An open protocol for exchanging secure pre-transaction messages that lets counterparties discover, validate, and authorize blockchain payments before funds move.
productsAndServices.name: Transaction Authorization Protocol (TAP)

productsAndServices.description: An embeddable user interface for identifying and verifying Travel Rule counterparties, collecting required information, and proving ownership of self-hosted wallets during crypto transactions.
productsAndServices.name: SafeConnect

productsAndServices.description: Regulatory guidance and jurisdiction-specific compliance information covering Travel Rule requirements, thresholds, enforcement status, counterparty obligations, and self-hosted wallet rules.
productsAndServices.name: Regulatory Engagement and Compliance Intelligence
